translations.Abdulbaki Gölpınarlı Meali: O, hıyanetle gizlice bakışı da bilir, gönüllerde gizlenen şeyleri de.

translations.M. Pickthall (English): He knoweth the traitor of the eyes, and that which the bosoms hide.
translations.Yusuf Ali (English): ((Allah)) knows of (the tricks) that deceive with the eyes,(4383) and all that the hearts (of men) conceal.(4384)
